attributes.review: Generally enjoy notion a lot - it’s one of the better note apps out there. The range of features is really good. But - two major problems prevent it from being awesome - you can’t upgrade your subscription! I signed up through Apple and now I want to bring on two other people to my “business” subscription. You can’t do it!!! I have to wait for my current subscription to expire, a month away, or start a new account and. Transfer everything which loses history and maybe some associations. Not much of a business subscription if you can’t more people!!!! The other really really bad thing is app startup time. I open my phone for a morning meeting, go to notion to start AI notes and it just sits there… I’m on WiFi, and the app takes so long to load up it misses the first part of the meeting - often the MOST critical part!  These two things take the app from great to something I can’t rely on. And if I can’t rely on it, then I have to have something else that I can rely on. Really unfortunate. Could be the perfect app - and then isn’t.
attributes.title: Pretty great until it isn’t

attributes.review: So far notion has been great, my number 1 go to for note taking among other things. But now the app has been more of nuisance than anything because it has several glitches now. For one, whenever I highlight a paragraph and try applying italic, or bold to it, it only applies to the first word and only allows me to edit that first word. Another recent development being that whenever I try highlighting a text to put it in a different color, by the time I go to the color menu the entire thing becomes deselected and uncolorable. Please fix this.
